title: Create the Gapminder dataset
text:
# Import necessary libraries
import pandas as pd
from gapminder import gapminder

# Rename 'lifeExp' to 'life_expectancy' and 'gdpPercap' to 'gdp_per_capita'
gapminder = gapminder.rename(columns={'lifeExp': 'life_expectancy',
                                      'pop': 'population_millions', 
                                      'gdpPercap': 'gdp_per_capita'})

# Convert population to millions
gapminder['population_millions'] = gapminder['population_millions'] / 1_000_000

# Create a new pandas DataFrame from the modified gapminder data
gapminder_df = pd.DataFrame(gapminder)

# Save the DataFrame as a CSV file
gapminder_df.to_csv('gapminder.csv', index=False)

# Print the first 3 rows of the DataFrame
print(gapminder_df.head(3))

title: Country Analysis - China
text: This page analyses changes in life expectancy, GDP per capita, and population over time for China.

title: Country Analysis - China
text:
Life Expectancy

library(ggplot2)
gap <- read.csv("gapminder.csv")
country_data <- subset(gap, country=="China")
ggplot(country_data, aes(x=year, y=life_expectancy)) +
  geom_line(color="steelblue", size=1.2) +
  geom_point(color="steelblue") +
  labs(title="Life Expectancy Over Time", x="Year", y="Life Expectancy") +
  theme_minimal()

gap_latest <- gap %>% filter(year == max(year))
name_mapping <- c(
  "Bosnia and Herzegovina" = "Bosnia and Herzegovina",
  "Central African Republic" = "Central African Republic",
  "Congo, Dem. Rep." = "Democratic Republic of the Congo",
  "Congo, Rep." = "Republic of the Congo",
  "Cote d'Ivoire" = "Ivory Coast",
  "Czech Republic" = "Czechia",
  "Dominican Republic" = "Dominican Rep.",
  "Equatorial Guinea" = "Equatorial Guinea",
  "Hong Kong, China" = "Hong Kong",
  "Korea, Dem. Rep." = "North Korea",
  "Korea, Rep." = "South Korea",
  "Reunion" = "Réunion",
  "Sao Tome and Principe" = "Sao Tome and Principe",
  "Slovak Republic" = "Slovakia",
  "Swaziland" = "Eswatini",
  "United States" = "United States of America",
  "West Bank and Gaza" = "Palestine",
  "Yemen, Rep." = "Yemen"
)
gap_latest$country <- ifelse(
  gap_latest$country %in% names(name_mapping),
  name_mapping[gap_latest$country],
  gap_latest$country
)
world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")
map_data <- merge(world, gap_latest, by.x="name", by.y="country", all.x=TRUE)
pal <- colorNumeric("YlOrRd", map_data$life_expectancy, na.color="lightgrey")
leaflet(map_data) %>%
  addTiles() %>%
  addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~pal(life_expectancy),
    weight = 1,
    color = "white",
    dashArray = "3",
    fillOpacity = 0.7,
    highlight = highlightOptions(
      weight = 2,
      color = "#666",
      fillOpacity = 0.9,
      bringToFront = TRUE
    ),
    label = ~paste0(name, ": ", ifelse(is.na(life_expectancy), "No data", round(life_expectancy,1)))
  ) %>%
  addLegend(
    pal = pal,
    values = ~life_expectancy,
    title = "Life Expectancy",
    position = "bottomright"
  )

title: Life Expectancy and GDP per Capita
text:
This page analyses the relationship between life expectancy and population across countries over time.

library(ggplot2)
gap <- read.csv("gapminder.csv")
ggplot(gap, aes(x=gdp_per_capita, y=life_expectancy, color=continent)) +
  geom_point(alpha=0.6) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  facet_wrap(~year) +
  labs(
    x = "GDP per Capita (log scale)",
    y = "Life Expectancy",
    color = "Continent"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
